name: New Windsor Mall
summary: New Windsor Mall has served the New Windsor community for over 30 years, offering convenient shopping at the corner of Route 32 and Old Forge Hill Road. With easy parking and accessible location, this neighborhood shopping center provides essential retail services to Orange County residents.
demographics: New Windsor Mall serves a diverse suburban and rural community in Orange County, New York, attracting middle-income families and working professionals from the Hudson Valley region. The primary trade area includes households with moderate to middle income levels, with a mix of young families, established homeowners, and retirees seeking convenient shopping options. Visitors typically prioritize value, accessibility, and practical shopping needs over luxury experiences, with strong demand for everyday services and essential retail.
description: New Windsor Mall has been a cornerstone of the New Windsor community for over 30 years, providing convenient shopping and services to residents of Orange County and the greater Hudson Valley region. Strategically located at the corner of Route 32 and Old Forge Hill Road at 367 Windsor Highway, the center offers easy accessibility and ample parking for shoppers throughout the area. The mall has established itself as a reliable neighborhood shopping destination, serving the practical needs of local families and professionals with a focus on convenience and community connection. With a solid 4-star rating from over 200 Google reviews, New Windsor Mall has maintained its reputation as a trusted local retail hub. The center's longevity and continued operation demonstrate its enduring value to the New Windsor community, providing essential retail services in an accessible, easy-to-navigate setting.
